prop: (∃ idx, idx < s.size ∧ s[idx]! = m) ∧ ∀ k, k < s.size → m ≤ s[k]!

children.invariant: 1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s.size ∧ (∃ idx, idx < i ∧ s[idx]! = m) ∧ ∀ k, k < i → m ≤ s[k]!
i ≤ s.size ∧ (found = true → (∃ idx, idx < i ∧ s[idx]! = r) ∧ m < r ∧ ∀ k, k < i → m < s[k]! → r ≤ s[k]!) ∧ (found = false → ∀ k, k < i → s[k]! = m)

children.expr: (i + 1, if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then s[i]! else r, if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then true else found)

lemmas.name: exit40
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : Array Int) (m r : Int) (found : Bool) (i : Nat) (h : secondSmallest_precond s), ((∃ idx, idx < s.size ∧ s[idx]! = m) ∧ ∀ k, k < s.size → m ≤ s[k]!) → (i ≤ s.size ∧ (found = true → (∃ idx, idx < i ∧ s[idx]! = r) ∧ m < r ∧ ∀ k, k < i → m < s[k]! → r ≤ s[k]!) ∧ (found = false → ∀ k, k < i → s[k]! = m)) → ¬ i < s.size → secondSmallest_postcond s r h
lemmas.proof:
by intro s m r found i h hm hinv hn
  obtain ⟨⟨idx, hidx, hmi⟩, hmin⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨hi, ht, hf⟩ := hinv
  have hi' : i = s.size := by omega
  subst hi'
  have hfound : found = true := by
    by_contra hne
    have hf' : found = false := by simpa using hne
    have hall := hf hf'
    obtain ⟨_, p, q, _, _, hpq⟩ := h
    exact hpq (by rw [hall p ‹p < s.size›, hall q ‹q < s.size›])
  obtain ⟨⟨j, hj, hsj⟩, hmr, hle⟩ := ht hfound
  unfold secondSmallest_postcond
  refine ⟨⟨j, hj, hsj⟩, idx, hidx, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro k hk hne
  have h1 := hmin k hk
  have : m < s[k]! := by omega
  exact hle k hk this

lemmas.name: step40
lemmas.statement: ∀ (s : Array Int) (m r : Int) (found : Bool) (i : Nat), ((∃ idx, idx < s.size ∧ s[idx]! = m) ∧ ∀ k, k < s.size → m ≤ s[k]!) → i < s.size → (i ≤ s.size ∧ (found = true → (∃ idx, idx < i ∧ s[idx]! = r) ∧ m < r ∧ ∀ k, k < i → m < s[k]! → r ≤ s[k]!) ∧ (found = false → ∀ k, k < i → s[k]! = m)) → (i + 1 ≤ s.size ∧ ((if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then true else found) = true → (∃ idx, idx < i + 1 ∧ s[idx]! = (if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then s[i]! else r)) ∧ m < (if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then s[i]! else r) ∧ ∀ k, k < i + 1 → m < s[k]! → (if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then s[i]! else r) ≤ s[k]!) ∧ ((if m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r) then true else found) = false → ∀ k, k < i + 1 → s[k]! = m))
lemmas.proof:
by intro s m r found i hm hi hinv
  obtain ⟨hle, ht, hf⟩ := hinv
  have hmin := hm.2
  by_cases hc : m < s[i]! ∧ (found = false ∨ s[i]! < r)
  · rw [if_pos hc, if_pos hc]
    have hmi := hc.1
    refine ⟨by omega, fun _ => ⟨⟨i, by omega, rfl⟩, hmi, ?_⟩, fun h => by simp at h⟩
    intro k hk hmk
    by_cases hk' : k = i
    · subst hk'; exact le_refl _
    · have hkl : k < i := by omega
      by_cases hfd : found = true
      · have := (ht hfd).2.2 k hkl hmk
        rcases hc.2 with h0 | h0
        · rw [hfd] at h0; simp at h0
        · omega
      · have hf0 : found = false := by simpa using hfd
        have := hf hf0 k hkl; omega
  · rw [if_neg hc, if_neg hc]
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hfd
      obtain ⟨⟨idx, hidx, hv⟩, hmr, hle'⟩ := ht hfd
      refine ⟨⟨idx, by omega, hv⟩, hmr, ?_⟩
      intro k hk hmk
      by_cases hk' : k = i
      · rw [hk'] at hmk ⊢
        by_contra hcon
        exact hc ⟨hmk, Or.inr (by omega)⟩
      · exact hle' k (by omega) hmk
    · intro hf0 k hk
      by_cases hk' : k = i
      · rw [hk']
        have := hmin i hi
        by_contra hcon
        exact hc ⟨by omega, Or.inl hf0⟩
      · exact hf hf0 k (by omega)
